sn24.36:1.2: Kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave sati kim upādāya kiṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati
sn24.36:1.3: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || || 4
sn24.36:2.1: Rūpe kho bhikkhave sati rūpam upādāya rūpam abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati
sn24.36:2.2: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || || 6-9
sn24.36:2.6: Viññāṇe sati viññāṇam upādāya viññāṇam abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati
